title: Portia Finding Suppression Current Pointer
description: Minimal explicit selection of one immutable revision in one Portia Finding Suppression series. Consumers must not infer current policy from the greatest revision, newest timestamp, filename, or directory order.
$comment: Application validation must establish expected prior pointer state, series identity, selected revision existence and validity, legal revision-chain selection, active applicability and expiry where presentation suppression is requested, atomic replacement, readback, and workspace containment.
